svg.title: MSCA-Lite spatial scales and energy gate
svg.desc: A schematic one-channel feature illustrates identity, average pooling at strides 2 and 4, bilinear resizing and the arithmetic mean. The illustration computes each operation on a 40 by 40 map. The lower line carries the original feature F directly to the final elementwise product.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 4. Scientific source: Figure 4 label sheet, MSCA_Lite.forward, and revision 44 equations (1)–(2). Routing informed by MSCALite.png.. Paper figure references: local academic-diagram atlas, DrivoR Fig. 1 (continuous paths and inline notation), TabICL Fig. 2 (operator notation and residual wiring).

g.inkscape:label: Pointwise arithmetic mean of the three aligned maps
Sigmoid energy gate with lambda 10 to the minus four
